rules.problem: Age > 65 missing; HIV 'not on ART' not captured and encoded as HIV AND viral load; nausea ANDed with persistent vomiting; Obstipation concept; shock/dehydration have only partial supporting rules.

summary: Most consequential: the two time-window comparisons (21-day exposure and 3-month new medication) use <= with time_ago, which under the house convention means 'at least that long ago', the reverse of the page. Second, the Urgent priority rule omits age > 65 and does not capture HIV 'not on ART'. Third, several concepts are imprecise (Obstipation for unable to pass stool, nausea without persistent, generic crust for honey-coloured crusts). SNOMED tool was unavailable (script error), so concepts were not re-verified.
